text: These maiden knights are the guardians of Avalon's sacred grounds, proclaiming the Empress's glory through their courage.
The Scions of the White Tower cultivate mind and body within this sacred abode, striving toward the day they master the infinite art of the blade.
The Sworn Guard of Asuryan are the great protectors of this supreme temple, warriors whose strength is enough to set them above all others.
The Watchers sit atop the clouds of Eataine, keeping vigil over the glorious homeland they hold dear.
The Radiants of Ellyrion are the finest riders in the entire elven realm. They grow up together with their steeds, becoming as one upon the battlefield, unstoppable in their advance.

The Waterdancers are the swordmasters of Cothique's nobility. These proud warriors have traveled the world for over a century alongside Cothique's proud naval might, honing their skills in duels against the strong.

The Throne Guard of Naggarith are the palace guard of Naggarond's royal court. To protect the throne, these iron-faced sentinels will fight to the death in every corridor and chamber of the palace against their foes.

The Lion-Speakers are the proudest warriors of the northern court, idols of the Phoenix King's lion prides. Their lives are bound to the lions—sometimes rivals, sometimes kin—but one thing is certain: they are Ulthuan's most lethal hunters.
The Windcallers are Lothern's most elite defensive force, drawn from among the most skilled nobility of Lothern. When disaster strikes, these warriors become the realm's most steadfast defenders.
The Dragon Lords charge into battle alongside their noble allies, and the whole world shall bear witness to the eternal oath between these two great races.
